settingsShowAchievementsPrefixesDescript: Show or hide prefixes [ACHIEVED] & [NOT ACHIEVED] from achievement name. For some games may need a full Steam Deck restart to actualize changes.
settingsInstructionsMD: To get your api key, go to [https://retroachievements.org/controlpanel.php](https://retroachievements.org/controlpanel.php) and log in to your account. you should see your api key in one of the entries in that page. either type it out in the api key box below or go to desktop mode and start steam in big picture mode so that you have access to the clipboard and paste it in,
settingsReset: Settings JSON schema has changed, resetting JSON
title: Emuchievements
noLogin: You are not logged in! Please login to view achievements.
friendsEnableDescription: Poll RetroAchievements for linked friends and show what they are playing and unlocking. Off by default.
friendsInstructionsBody:
Open your RetroAchievements profile settings on the website and put this exact text in your Motto:

%%

Friends running Emuchievements can then verify your account automatically. This publishes the fact that your Steam account and RetroAchievements account belong to the same person.
friendsNoSteamId: Could not read your SteamID64, so the motto token cannot be shown. You can still link friends by hand below.
friendsPlaytimeNoticeBody: RetroAchievements does not expose playtime through its API, and Steam does not share non-Steam game playtime with friends. Only 'playing now' and achievement unlocks are available.
friendsScanDescription: Looks up each unlinked friend's Steam name on RetroAchievements. Accounts that published your friend's SteamID64 in their motto are linked automatically; name-only matches are shown as suggestions for you to confirm.
friendsAddManualDescription: Use this when a friend is missing from the list below. Their SteamID64 is the 17-digit number from their Steam profile URL.
friendsInvalidSteamId: That is not a valid SteamID64 (expected 17 digits starting with 7656).
friendsNoFriends: No Steam friends found. The friends list could not be read, but you can still add links by hand once you know a friend's RetroAchievements username.
friendsLinkSaved: Linked %% (not verified - they have not published your friend's SteamID64)
friendsNoLinks: No friends linked yet. Link a RetroAchievements account in Settings to see their activity.
friendsNoActivity: No recent activity from linked friends.
